question: Alcohols react with sodium leading to the evolution of which of the following gases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**hydrogen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• Alcohol with the chemical formula **C₂H₅OH** is **ethanol**.
 
• **Alcohols react **with **sodium **metals to produce **hydrogen** **gas **and **sodium alkoxide**, which are both released.
